title: [.NET]: Allow to export to web with static LibGodot using a normal C# plugin

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118976
- Allows for a third party solution for https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70796

Depends on:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121502
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123311
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123911
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123922
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123251
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/123842

## Additional information

Use a normal C# `browser-wasm` publish with statically linked Godot as a library using static LibGodot.

This series of PRs strips as much as possible from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118976 and separates it into a bunch of bug fixes and feature PRs. Also rewrites some of it when I though of a better way to implement needed functionality.

You can read the demo's `README` if you want to see upsides/downsides of the LibGodot approach for the mono web export.

Because the LibGodot bootstrapping is so separate from the rest of the code, it can be packaged separately with the C# plugin, so it doesn't need to be a part of the main repository.

Demo: https://github.com/NoctemCat/GodotPRDemos/tree/libgodot_mono_web_minimal

The changes could be less if I fully wrote a new `EditorExportPlatformExtension` from the grounds up for the plugin, but I am kind of lazy atm, will revisit later after some PRs this one depends on get merged (if they get merged). Only the latest commit actually belongs to this PR.

This PR only really need the changes inside these files to work:
- `modules/mono/config.py`
- `platform/web/SCsub`
- `platform/web/detect.py`

But the other changes made it possible to use the existing Web export, and I feel that `"dotnet/project/ignore_not_supported_export_error"` will also be useful for anyone who wants to use a custom `EditorExportPlatformExtension` with the C# Godot editor, and they don't want to rely on [reflection](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15481#issuecomment-5610621192), and internal `GodotSharp` details as they can be changed at any moment.

No AI used.
